title: Book One · Chapter 24: Tomorrow
story:
There are four school days left before the display. Miss Wu asks each child to bring the work or a clear plan on Monday. The display itself is on Wednesday afternoon.

Ronan counts the days on his fingers. He has very little time left.

Their first kite has paper and a tail. It still points at the ground. The other three kites are not ready. He has not made their frames yet.

He tells Leo about the wet paper on Friday.

Leo stops folding the string card. "Is all of Jun's paper wet?"

"One corner is left."

"How big is the dry corner?"

Ronan shows him with his hands.

"That isn't a kite," Leo says.

"I know."

The girl from the other class comes to their door at break. "Can my little sister have a red tail on her kite?" she asks.

Leo steps back. Ronan waits for him to speak. Leo often speaks first.

"Maybe," Ronan says.

"Is it done?"

"Not yet."

"Tomorrow?"

Ronan wants to say yes again. He looks away from the girl's face.

"I'll try."

The girl runs off. Leo watches her go.

"She heard yes."

"I didn't say yes."

"You did not tell her about the wet paper."

Ronan takes the string card from the desk. "You could help."

"I am helping with our kite. I can't make three others by tomorrow."

"I can't make three kites by tomorrow either."

They look at each other. Ronan needs to tell the girl that, too. He did not. Now she is back in her own room.

Miss Wu calls the class back. There is reading to do. Ronan loses his place twice. Leo points to the right line the first time. The second time, he is busy with his own book.

At home, Mum has put the three promise squares beside the material packet. She asks which family he will tell first.

"On Monday."

"What happens on Monday?"

"They bring their things."

"And they may expect yours."

Ronan takes off one shoe. He doesn't take off the other. One sock is on the cool floor. He does not move. He does not want to face Jun on Monday.

Dad comes in carrying a small repaired stool. He finished a paid job. The owner will collect the stool tomorrow. Ronan looks at the stool's straight legs.

"Did you ever promise to do a job and then fail to finish it?"

Dad puts the stool down.

"Yes."

"What happened?"

"People were angry. Some had good reason."

"Did you say you were sorry?"

"I did. Then I had to do more than say it."

Mum says dinner is ready. Dad washes his hands. He doesn't turn the answer into a long story. Ronan wants to ask more. But he is afraid of Dad's answer. He puts his bowls on the table instead.

After dinner, he puts the unfinished strips into a bag. He adds the dry paper scraps and the list. He will bring them on Monday. On Monday, he will show them the paper and strips. There are no new kites. He needs to tell them the truth.

He leaves the empty space in the bag where Jun's kite should be. Before bed, he looks in once more. There is still no kite in the bag. Ronan closes it again. He has to tell Jun that soon.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：ready＝准备好的；list＝清单；tomorrow＝明天；collect＝领取。

理解问题：

1. Leo 为什么不愿再替 Ronan 回答？
2. Ronan 需要向同学说明什么事实？
